name: SwissAI Click to Call
author: Swissvoip SA

sections.description:
SwissAI Click to Call puts a call button on your WordPress site. The visitor clicks, allows the microphone and talks to your SwissAI voice agent directly from the browser.

  • One agent per language: a WebRTC client for each language, the button uses the language of the page (works with Polylang and WPML)
  • Shortcode [swissai_call] to place the button in any page or post, [swissai_call lang="de"] to force a language
  • Optional floating button on every page
  • Button texts can be changed in the settings or per shortcode: [swissai_call label="Talk to us" hangup="End call"]
  • The secret key stays on your server and never reaches the browser

A SwissAI account is required. The button talks to a voice agent that you create in the SwissAI dashboard: create your account on swissai.dev.

The settings page is translated into Italian, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese and Chinese; the button and its messages speak the language of the page.

External services

This plugin connects to SwissAI (developers.swissai.dev), a service of Swissvoip SA, to start browser calls to your voice agent.

  • When a visitor clicks the call button, your server sends the client name and the secret key you saved in the settings to https://developers.swissai.dev/api/webrtc/token and receives a temporary password valid for one call.
  • On pages that show the button, the browser loads https://developers.swissai.dev/js/call.js, which opens the call (audio from the visitor’s microphone) to the SwissAI switchboard.

No data is sent until the button is on a page; no call is started until the visitor clicks it.

Terms of service: https://www.swissai.dev/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://www.swissai.dev/privacy.html
sections.installation:
1. Create a SwissAI account on swissai.dev: the button talks to a SwissAI voice agent and does not work without one.
  2. In the SwissAI dashboard create an agent for each language of your site: its instructions, its knowledge base and, if you want, the tools it uses to book or look things up.
  3. In the dashboard open Telephony › WebRTC clients, create one client per agent and add your site’s domain. Copy the client name (wc_…) and the secret key (wk_…): the key is shown only once.
  4. In WordPress install and activate the plugin, then open Settings › SwissAI Click to Call and paste each client name and secret key in the row of its language; mark one as default.
  5. Add the shortcode [swissai_call] to a page, or enable the floating button. The site must use HTTPS: browsers allow the microphone only there.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SwissAI account?

Yes. You create the agent and the WebRTC client in the SwissAI dashboard.

Are calls billed?

Calls from the button count as minutes on your SwissAI plan, like any other call.

The button does not start the call

Check that your site’s domain is listed in the WebRTC client in the SwissAI dashboard and that the site is served over HTTPS (browsers require it for the microphone).

1.2.0

  • Getting started box on the settings page, with the link to create a SwissAI account.
  • Settings page translated into Italian, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese and Chinese.
  • “Settings” link in the plugin list.
